name: bench_vortex_zed_four_stereo
description: A Hugging Face dataset of stereo imagery captured with ZED-style setups for evaluating stereo matching and depth estimation models across real-world scenes. Intended to measure stereo correspondence quality, depth map accuracy, and robustness across different lighting and geometry conditions. Typically used by researchers developing depth-estimation, stereo-matching, or multi-view perception pipelines.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted dataset with limited but growing use among stereo/depth researchers and robotics practitioners.
